items.title: Nexa Monthly Newsletter September 2026: Ahead of the Storm
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The September newsletter recaps the release of full node 2.2.0.0, which prepares the network for Tailstorm, and the launch of AI skills alongside a Starter App for building Nexa apps with a wallet already wired in.

items.title: Seconds, Not Minutes: What Tailstorm Means for Developers Building on Nexa
items.author: jQrgen
items.summary: jQrgen, who runs this site, writes about how Tailstorm's subblocks should cut confirmation times from minutes to seconds, which matters most for checkouts, point of sale and token apps.

items.title: Hardware Acceleration: The Blitz Card
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The fourth article in the hardware series introduces Blitz, a card designed by chief scientist Peter Rizun that checks digital signatures in hardware and is now running as a prototype.

items.title: BUIP 225: Re-elect Peter R for Bitcoin Unlimited Secretary
items.author: Peter_R
items.summary: Peter Rizun puts himself forward for another two-year term as Bitcoin Unlimited secretary, the role that oversees how BU's funds are managed.

items.title: Build On Nexa: Start Building Today
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: Build On Nexa, the developer onboarding site, has reorganised its docs and SDK sections and refreshed its design, with TypeScript, Kotlin and soon Python covered.

items.title: Build on Nexa: AI-Assisted Development with David Thibodeau
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: David Thibodeau walks through Nexa's AI-assisted development tools and AI skills, aimed at helping both experienced and less technical builders create Nexa apps.

items.title: Nexa September Highlights: Full-Node 2.2.0.0 Released
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The September highlights centre on full node 2.2.0.0 and explain the planned Tailstorm design, with summary blocks about every two minutes and subblocks about every three seconds.

items.title: Monthly Development Updates: August 2026
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: August's development report covers the full node 2.2.0.0 release, progress toward activating Tailstorm, and work on smart contract tooling, wallets and the explorer.

items.title: Tailstorm: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) Combined With Traditional Blockchain
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: An explainer on Tailstorm, Nexa's planned upgrade that combines a short-lived DAG of subblocks with a traditional blockchain to get transactions mined within seconds.

items.title: Nexa is 13,000× more energy efficient than Bitcoin
items.author: jQrgen
items.summary: jQrgen, who runs this site, compares energy use per transaction for Bitcoin and Nexa at the same network consumption and argues Nexa's throughput makes it about 13,000 times more efficient. That figure is his own calculation using benchmarked and projected throughput.

items.title: Scaling By Circuit
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The third article in the hardware series explains how the circuit-based validation engine can scale, building on Peter Rizun's talk in Sydney.

items.title: ### Announcing the next BU Vote: 9 to 14 October 2026 ###
items.author: solex
items.summary: Bitcoin Unlimited announces its next member vote on proposals (BUIPs), running from 9 to 14 October 2026 and recorded using the VotePeer app.

items.title: Advance notice: Candidate Applications for BU Secretary Oct 2026-28
items.author: solex
items.summary: Bitcoin Unlimited gives advance notice that the secretary post is up for election, and candidates need to submit a BUIP before the October vote.

items.title: Nexa Full-Node 2.2.0.0: The Final Checkpoint Before The Tailstorm
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The Nexa team announces full node 2.2.0.0, a preparatory release that includes the Tailstorm code, and asks everyone who runs a node to upgrade before the hard fork.

items.title: Full node 2.2.0.0 problem
items.author: elipso
items.summary: A Windows user reports that full node 2.2.0.0 crashes on startup. The team traced it to non-English characters in the data directory path and gave a workaround while a fix is prepared.

items.title: Nexa Monthly Newsletter August 2026: Redesign of the Mining Puzzle
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The August newsletter covers the launch of NexaPoW 2.0, Andrew Clifford's explanation of Nexa's architecture, and progress on a hardware node that validates signatures.

items.title: Nexa: The Art of Building a Blockchain
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: A non-technical look back at the people and ideas behind Bitcoin Unlimited and Nexa, from the early BitcoinTalk days onward.

items.title: Wally Wallet: The Web3 Login That Killed the Browser Plugin
items.author: Wally
items.summary: This post explains how Wally Wallet lets users log in to web apps and approve each action from their phone, instead of relying on a browser plugin.

items.title: The Cellular Automaton: Inside Nexa's Next Proof-of-Work
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: An explainer on the cellular automaton planned for NexaPoW 2.0, Nexa's redesigned proof-of-work algorithm.

items.title: Nexa: La Apuesta de Bitcoin Unlimited por la Escalabilidad en la Capa Base
items.author: Luis Enrique ₿ ⚡️
items.summary: A Spanish-language overview of how Bitcoin Unlimited approaches base-layer scaling with Nexa. It covers the reworked UTXO model, native tokens in extended Script, and the decision to stay with proof-of-work. The author notes that throughput in practice depends on load.

items.title: Monthly Development Updates: July 2026
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: July's development report covers more than 100 merges across 13 repositories, led by Tailstorm testing and hardening, plus explorer, vault and SDK work.

items.title: Nexa August Highlights: NexaPoW 2.0 Introduced
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The August highlights introduce NexaPoW 2.0, described by Bitcoin Unlimited president Andrew Clifford as proof-of-work that is indirectly useful to the network.

items.title: A Node Made of Wires
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: Part two of the hardware series explains how Peter Rizun is building a Nexa node entirely out of basic logic gates and wires.

items.title: Rethinking Proof of Work: Understanding Nexa's Architecture with Andrew Clifford
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: In a webinar with EvolveH3r, Bitcoin Unlimited president Andrew Clifford explains how proof-of-work came about, how Nexa's coin issuance works, and what it takes to run a node or mine.

items.title: Nexa Monthly Newsletter July 2026: Hardware Acceleration
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The July newsletter leads with the Blitz hardware acceleration project and the start of an article series about it, along with a recap of the 4th anniversary.

items.title: Wally Wallet: Peer-to-Peer Offers
items.author: Wally
items.summary: Wally Wallet's peer-to-peer offers let users sell tokens or NFTs for NEXA through a shareable link or QR code, settled in a single atomic transaction with no exchange in between.

items.title: How does TokaDex handle order book ordering and UTXO splitting/recomposition in the UTXO model?
items.author: aiya
items.summary: A community member asks how TokaDex will sort its order book and split or combine UTXOs, given that Nexa uses a UTXO model and not accounts.

items.title: Why Nexa Builds Hardware
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The first article in the hardware series explains why Nexa is building Blitz, a chip that verifies signatures to remove the main computing bottleneck in scaling.

items.title: Nexa 4th Anniversary Spaces with Andrew Stone, Andrea Suisani and David Thibodeau
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: A recap of the 4th anniversary Spaces on X, where Andrew Stone, Andrea Suisani and David Thibodeau looked back on four years of Nexa and its first halving.

items.title: Monthly Development Updates: June 2026
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: June's development report covers the second hard fork being split into smaller reviewable pieces, a busy month for the explorer, the Nexa Warriors contract suite and time-lock vaults.

items.title: Nexa Explorer: New Features
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The Nexa Explorer gets a refreshed front page, transaction pages that work on phones, and the option to self-host it with a single command.

items.title: NexScript Playground Upgrades
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The NexScript Playground now has a full code editor and five example contracts that can be written, tested and run against the network from the browser.

items.title: Nexa July Highlights: A Layer of Ownership
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The July highlights cover Nexa's pitch for on-chain gaming ownership and an updated development roadmap for 2026 and part of 2027.

items.title: Moving Beyond Centralized Gaming: Nexa Blockchain with Steven van den Meiracker
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: In a webinar with EvolveH3r, Steven van den Meiracker presents Nexa for gaming and demos Nexa Warriors, an on-chain card game in development.

items.title: An Artifact of the 4th Nexa Anniversary
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: To mark Nexa's 4th anniversary on 21 June 2026, the team sent a limited commemorative NFT to listeners of its Spaces on X.

items.title: Nexa Monthly Newsletter January 2026: The Chapter of Acceleration
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The January newsletter looks at the planned hard fork, protocol work and ecosystem projects for 2026, plus Nexa's sponsorship of Bitcoin MENA in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Nexa Monthly Newsletter December 2025: Scalability, Reliability, and Programmability
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The December newsletter wraps up 2025 with development progress, team growth and plans for 2026.

items.title: Nexa Monthly Newsletter November 2025: Ten Years of Bitcoin Unlimited
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The November newsletter marks ten years of Bitcoin Unlimited and covers conference appearances, governance updates and wallet and tooling progress.

items.title: Nexa Monthly Newsletter October 2025: Breaking New Ground by Empowering Builders
items.author: Nexa
items.summary: The October newsletter covers Andrew Stone at Boston Blockchain Week, new builder programmes and other community events.
